reserves.name: Overnight reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury obligations

sources.label: KPMG PYUSD Redemption Assets Report - May 2026

reserveReview.rationale: KPMG's May examination reports $2.768410 billion of overnight reverse repurchase agreements and $262.423747 million of cash against $3.030833747 billion of redemption assets at May 29, 2026. Those amounts normalize to 91.34% repo and 8.66% cash; no direct Treasury bills or government money market funds were held.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of the PYUSD Redemption Assets Report as of May 29, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the report anonymizes the two repo counterparties and commercial banks.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report confirms segregated, unencumbered reserves and prohibits sale or repledge of repo collateral, but anonymizes the commercial banks, counterparties, and custodian and does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness.
